rca of the issue: Previous 500s were caused by returning the same doc that Mongo mutated with an ObjectId `_id` after insert_one. Fix (already applied by E1): pop `_id` (and `password_hash` for users) before returning. Verified via successful POST /api/invoices returning JSON with invoice_number TE/2026-27/xxxx, and POST /api/users returning fields id/email/name/role/created_at without _id or password_hash.
